Bash(cd E:/Projects/POS && gh issue create --title "QR Code Generation for Kiosk Access" --label "new-feature,phase-4" --milestone "v1.0 - MVP" --body "$\(cat <<'EOF'
## Overview
One-time QR code generation pointing to the kiosk URL. Printed and placed on counter/tables for customers to scan.

## Requirements
- Install `qrcode.react` package
- QR code screen accessible from POS settings or admin
- Encodes static kiosk URL \(e.g., `https://joestreet.cafe/kiosk?qr=1`\)
- `?qr=1` param flags the user as a QR mobile customer \(triggers location check\)
- Download as PNG image
- Print via browser Print API
- One-time generation — same QR code every day, does not change
- Show URL with copy button
- Info bullets: one-time, location-verified, store-aware

## Kiosk Access Logic
```
QR scan \(mobile, has ?qr=1\):
  → Store open? → Location check \(100m\) → Kiosk menu
  → Store closed? → StoreClosed screen

Direct kiosk URL \(tablet, no ?qr param, sessionStorage flag\):
  → Store open? → Skip location check → Kiosk menu
  → Store closed? → StoreClosed screen

No QR param + no session flag \(random visitor\):
  → Redirect to StoreClosed or block access
```

## Screen
- **POS/QRGenerator** \(1280x800\) — Pencil ID: `cbSrk`
- Route: `/pos/qr` or `/admin/qr`
EOF
\)")
